statement.zh: 海湾奥尔梅克为整个中美洲「母文化」——Flannery & Marcus 等强烈质疑的模型。
statement.en: Gulf Olmec as pan-Mesoamerican “mother culture” is a model strongly contested (e.g. Flannery & Marcus).

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
